title: 12 Best Craft Beer Bars in Oslo

venues.name: RØØR
venues.quickTake: Oslo's undisputed craft beer throne — 64 taps of rotating craft beer from Norway and beyond, with some of the most knowledgeable staff in the city.

venues.name: Crow Bar & Brewery
venues.quickTake: Oslo's veteran craft beer bar and brewery — they brew their own beer in-house plus pour 20+ guest taps. A Torggata institution.

venues.name: Brygg Oslo
venues.quickTake: The biggest selection in Oslo — around 150 beers available on tap, can, and bottle. A beer nerd's paradise.

venues.name: Grünerløkka Brygghus
venues.quickTake: Neighborhood brewpub in the heart of trendy Grünerløkka — brews their own beer and captures the local vibe perfectly.

venues.name: Schouskjelleren Mikrobryggeri
venues.quickTake: Oslo's highest-rated craft beer spot (4.7★) — a microbrewery in the cellars of the former Schou Brewery, which was Oslo's oldest brewery when it closed in 1981.

venues.name: Oslo Mikrobryggeri
venues.quickTake: One of Oslo's original microbreweries — established on upscale Bogstadveien, brewing since the 1990s. A city institution.

venues.name: Amundsen Bryggeri & Spiseri
venues.quickTake: Amundsen is one of Norway's most respected craft breweries — and their city center brewpub serves the full range alongside a solid food menu.

venues.name: Territoriet
venues.quickTake: A Grünerløkka gem that straddles the line between natural wine bar and craft beer destination — excellent curated selection of both.

venues.name: Nedre Foss Gård
venues.quickTake: A riverside beer garden by the Akerselva waterfall — one of Oslo's most beautiful spots to drink craft beer in summer.

venues.name: Hopyard
venues.quickTake: A craft beer specialist inside Mathallen — Oslo's premier food hall. Combine world-class food shopping with excellent Norwegian craft beer.

venues.name: Håndslag
venues.quickTake: A no-frills craft beer bar popular with locals — less tourist-heavy than the big names but with a loyal following.

venues.name: Den Glade Gris
venues.quickTake: Oslo's most-reviewed restaurant with 5,100+ reviews and a 4.6 rating — excellent craft beer selection alongside outstanding food.
